migrations.description: Finds local executors that declare a custom hasher, which is deprecated and will be removed in Nx 25. Rewriting a hasher as target inputs means reading what its code hashes, so the rewrite is driven by an AI prompt; the generator only reports each hasher.
migrations.name: 24-0-0-move-custom-hashers-to-inputs

migrations.description: Sets affected.legacy to true in nx.json so nx affected keeps selecting whole projects. Nx 24 selects individual affected tasks by default.
migrations.name: 24-0-0-enable-legacy-affected

migrations.description: Renames the ultracache target options "ignoredReads" and "ignoredWrites" to "ignoreReads" and "ignoreWrites", and renames .nx/workflows/sandboxing-config.yaml to ultracache-config.yaml with its "exclude-reads" and "exclude-writes" keys renamed to "ignore-reads" and "ignore-writes".
migrations.name: 24-0-0-rename-ultracache-ignore-options

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/vitest` executors to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/eslint` executors to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Replaces the removed `setParserOptionsProject` generator option with `enableTypedLinting` in the generator defaults of `nx.json` and project configuration, so generators resolve typed linting as before.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-replace-set-parser-options-project

migrations.description: Sets `readyWhen: { signal: true }` on `@nx/web:file-server` targets that get no `readyWhen` from their own configuration or `targetDefaults`, so tasks that depend on them with `waitFor: 'ready'` start once the server is listening. Those targets also get their build target as a dependency.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-add-ready-when-signal

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/webpack` executors to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Converts webpack configs that use the removed `composePlugins`, `withNx`, `withWeb` and `withReact` helpers with `@nx/webpack:convert-config-to-webpack-plugin`, then hands an AI prompt the projects it could not convert and the `.old` configs it left behind.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-migrate-compose-plugins

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/vite` executors, and `@nx/vitest:test` targets, to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Replace `nxViteTsPaths` with Vite's native `resolve.tsconfigPaths`, then migrate the remaining deprecated vite configuration helpers while preserving custom behavior.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-migrate-config-helpers

migrations.description: Register @nx/js/typescript with its typecheck target in workspaces that use @nx/vite/plugin without it, since @nx/vite/plugin no longer infers typecheck targets except for Vue projects.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-register-typescript-plugin-for-typecheck

migrations.description: Add the `nxReadySignal()` plugin to the Vite configs of application projects, so that `@nx/vite/plugin` infers `readyWhen: { signal: true }` for their dev and preview targets; an AI prompt finishes the configs the codemod cannot edit safely.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-add-ready-signal-plugin

migrations.description: Register @nx/js/typescript with its typecheck target in workspaces that use @nx/react/router-plugin without it, and remove the router plugin's typecheckTargetName option, since @nx/react/router-plugin no longer infers typecheck targets.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-register-typescript-plugin-for-typecheck

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/storybook` executors to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Sets a `readyWhen` that waits for the Storybook port on `@storybook/angular:start-storybook` targets that get no `readyWhen` from their own configuration or `targetDefaults`, so tasks that depend on them with `waitFor: 'ready'` start once Storybook is listening. Also sets `continuous: true` on those targets when neither they nor `targetDefaults` set `continuous` and they don't set `smokeTest`.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-add-start-storybook-ready-when

migrations.description: Adds an `id` to Storybook `HIGHLIGHT` payloads emitted through `useChannel`, which Storybook 9.1.21 and 10.6.2 ignore without one. An AI prompt then finishes the Highlight changes in every file that uses `storybook/highlight` or `clickEvent`, including menu items that must replace `clickEvent` with `clickable` and a `HIGHLIGHT_MENU_CLICK` listener.
migrations.name: update-24-0-1-add-highlight-ids
